scores.evidence: metrics.json shows no hard failures: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid and unknown-block errors, 0 broken images. The 2-column definition and goal tables, the 4-row MoSCoW table and the 3-node screen-flow diagram all fit at 390 px without clipping (mobile-jp-06, -07, -09, -14). Diagram labels are large and in the right language in both locales (desktop-jp-09, desktop-en-10).

textOnlyScreens is empty for all three shots. Desktop JP median is 37 chars per line (target 30-40) and EN median is 71 (target 60-75). Every screen has a heading, table, figure, prompt or check, and there are no walls of text or empty gaps across the 25 mobile screens.

The EN screens are fully translated, with no stray Japanese in the tables, figure labels, prompts, steps or the 6 knowledge-check questions (desktop-en-05, -10, -13). The figure has a 'Describe the figure in words' / 図の説明を読む disclosure (mobile-jp-14, desktop-en-10). On mobile, no control sits under the top or bottom bars, and the text has good contrast.

niceToHave: In the 2-2 goal/feature definition list on desktop JP, the 機能 definition wraps and leaves 「す。」 alone on the second line (pages/desktop-jp-04.png). Trimming a few characters, for example 「アプリが『すること』です」 to 「アプリがすること」, would keep it on one line at 680 px.

In the screen-flow figure, the two edge labels 追加ボタン and 保存 sit close to the crossing curved arrows (pages/mobile-jp-14.png, pages/desktop-jp-09.png). They are readable, but more vertical spacing or shorter labels such as 追加 / 保存 would make it clearer which arrow each label belongs to.
reader: the small grey flashcard hint 「クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる」 / 'Click or press Space to flip' has fairly low contrast (pages/mobile-jp-23.png, pages/desktop-en-16.png).
reader: a faint preview/status strip shows through behind the top bar on desktop (pages/desktop-en-01.png, pages/desktop-jp-01.png).
summary: The lesson renders cleanly in all three shots, and metrics.json reports no hard failures. Tables, the MoSCoW breakdown, the screen-flow diagram and both prompt blocks are readable at 390 px, and the EN version is fully translated. The only items are cosmetic: one orphaned 「す。」 in the 機能 definition on desktop JP and crowded edge labels in the diagram.
